principles.title: Correctness is a feature
principles.body: In telemetry, payments and membership records, a fast wrong answer is worse than a slow right one. Design for the failure case first.

principles.title: I've been the customer
principles.body: I've run the organisations I build for. I know which features get used and which quietly die in month three.

principles.title: Constraints are the spec
principles.body: Offline devices, a July-to-June year, a substation protocol from 2003. The awkward reality is the actual specification.

principles.title: Write it down
principles.body: Decision records, migration plans, API documentation. If it only lives in my head, I've built a dependency, not a system.

facts.v: Node, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis
